name: Calendar
description: Mortar calendar: one current date shared by a month grid with keyboard navigation, a twelve-month year view with one roving tab stop, and week and day time grids where timed events sit on an hour scale and collapse to an agenda when narrow. An opt-in month agenda lists the selected day's meetings beside the month (below it when narrow). Dates are YYYY-MM-DD strings handled in UTC.

props.month: string (YYYY-MM; omit to follow the current date)
props.date: string (YYYY-MM-DD; the current date shown by every view; omit to let the calendar manage it)
props.onDateChange: (date: string) => void (after navigation in any view)
props.events: CalendarEvent[] ({ id: string; date: string; title: string; time?: string; start?: string; end?: string; media?: ReactNode (avatar or icon in the agenda) })
props.onEventSelect: (id: string) => void (makes events in week and day views, and in the agenda, buttons)
props.agenda: boolean (month view only; lists the selected day's events, or the current date's, beside the month under a "Schedule for" heading one level below the title; below the month when narrow)
props.dayStartHour: number (events outside the hours are drawn at the edge and marked as cut off)
props.headingLevel: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 (default 2; month and day headings are one level below)

contract.usage: Import { Calendar } from @tonycodes-ui/mortar. Compose with the public typed props.
contract.avoid: Do not copy implementations, override central colours or grant component approval.
contract.accessibility: Verify accessible names, keyboard interaction, visible focus, responsive layout and supported states.
